reason: We have always washed by hand at home and it costs nothing, so I don't feel any need for a machine at all, let alone one with a battery. I can afford ₹22,000, but I would rather put that money into the farm or the shop.
objection: When the power goes, my borewell pump stops too, so there is no water to fill the machine anyway. A battery that finishes the wash does not solve my real problem, and the women at home already manage fine by hand.
would_change_my_mind: If my wife or mother asked for one, or I saw a neighbour's machine save real time and labour for a full year without trouble at the dealer.
